turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Phantom of the Paradise
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After record producer Swan (Paul Williams) steals the music of songwriter Winslow Leach (William Finley) and gives it to one of his bands, Leach sneaks into Swan's offices. Catching Leach, Swan frames him for dealing drugs, which lands him in prison. After Leach breaks out and again attempts to sabotage Swan's empire, an accident crushes his face. Leach then dons a costume and becomes the Phantom, intent on ruining Swan while saving singer Phoenix (Jessica Harper) from a terrible fate. (Musical comedy) - 1974

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cat People
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Irena Dubrovna (Simone Simon), a New York City–based fashion designer who hails from Serbia, begins a romance with marine engineer Oliver Reed (Kent Smith). After the couple gets married, Oliver becomes concerned about Irena's notion that she is cursed and may transform into a large cat in the heat of passion. Confiding in his beautiful assistant, Alice Moore (Jane Randolph), about his marital issues, Oliver unwittingly triggers Irena's curse, with tragic results. (Horror) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Seventh Victim
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After young Mary Gibson (Kim Hunter) discovers that her older sister Jacqueline (Jean Brooks) has disappeared, she leaves her boarding school and heads to New York City to track down her sibling. Arriving at Jacqueline's apartment, Mary finds ominous signs of trouble, with her sister nowhere in sight. Aided by psychiatrist Dr. Louis Judd (Tom Conway) and others, Mary gets drawn deeper into the mystery, and evidence begins to point to the involvement of a sinister cult. (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Leopard Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Latin dancer Clo-Clo (Margo) begins to overshadow nightclub singer Kiki Walker (Jean Brooks), Kiki's agent, Jerry Manning (Dennis O'Keefe), decides to spice up his client's act with an enormous black leopard on a leash. But the big cat escapes from the club -- and soon after, a young girl (Margaret Landry) and others are found dead around their small town. When evidence suggests that the killer may be human, suspicion falls on the leopard's Native American owner (Abner Biberman). (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the United States. (Horror) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Eye of the Devil
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A French winegrower (David Niven) returns to Bordeaux with his wife (Deborah Kerr) and family to face ritual sacrifice for another bad year. (Horror) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Blithe Spirit
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Skeptical novelist Charles Condomine (Rex Harrison) invites self-proclaimed medium Madame Arcati (Margaret Rutherford) to his home for a séance, hoping to gather material for a new book. When the hapless psychic accidentally summons the spirit of Condomine's late wife, Elvira (Kay Hammond), his home and life are quickly turned into a shambles as his wife's ghost torments both himself and his new bride, Ruth (Constance Cummings). David Lean directed this adaptation of Noel Coward's hit play. (Fantasy) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After young Mary Gibson (Kim Hunter) discovers that her older sister Jacqueline (Jean Brooks) has disappeared, she leaves her boarding school and heads to New York City to track down her sibling. Arriving at Jacqueline's apartment, Mary finds ominous signs of trouble, with her sister nowhere in sight. Aided by psychiatrist Dr. Louis Judd (Tom Conway) and others, Mary gets drawn deeper into the mystery, and evidence begins to point to the involvement of a sinister cult. (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Leopard Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Latin dancer Clo-Clo (Margo) begins to overshadow nightclub singer Kiki Walker (Jean Brooks), Kiki's agent, Jerry Manning (Dennis O'Keefe), decides to spice up his client's act with an enormous black leopard on a leash. But the big cat escapes from the club -- and soon after, a young girl (Margaret Landry) and others are found dead around their small town. When evidence suggests that the killer may be human, suspicion falls on the leopard's Native American owner (Abner Biberman). (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Murder Most Foul
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The sole dissenting member of a jury that aims to convict a man of murdering an actress, beloved Agatha Christie character Miss Jane Marple joins a theatrical company to investigate the crime on her own. As she gets closer to H. Driffold Cosgood and his fellow performers, yet another actor is found dead. Her digging uncovers evil deeds that date back several years, but Miss Marple finds herself in danger as she closes in on the killer. (Mystery, Crime drama) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gone With the Wind
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Presented as originally released in 1939. Includes themes and character depictions which may be offensive and problematic to contemporary audiences. Epic Civil War drama focuses on the life of petulant Southern belle Scarlett O'Hara. Starting with her idyllic life on a sprawling plantation, the film traces her survival through the tragic history of the South during the Civil War and Reconstruction, and her tangled love affairs with Ashley Wilkes and Rhett Butler. (Romance, Historical drama, War) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Strategic Air Command
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Saga of the US Air Force special bomber unit during the Cold War era. A professional baseball player is recalled to military service because of the expert flying skills he acquired during World War II. Although the athlete and his wife are both reluctant to give up civilian life, both come to realize the importance of the defense mission. The film features spectacular aerial footage of big bombers on maneuvers. (Adventure) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Mountain Road
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Maj. Baldwin (James Stewart) is an American officer stationed in China during World War II charged with stopping the advance of the Japanese army and protecting civilians. One of his tasks is destroying infrastructure to stop the progress of enemy troops. Baldwin is put in command of a unit and is taken aback by how primitive China is. He meets widow Sue-Mei Hung (Lisa Lu) who attempts to explain local customs, but she is ultimately put off by his brutal methods. (War, Drama) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Garden of Eden
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Toni LeBrun (Corinne Griffith) is beautiful jazz age singer who takes a job in a Paris cabaret, where she is propositioned by Henry von Glessing (Lowell Sherman), a rich patron of the club. When she refuses his advances, she is fired and joins her wardrobe mistress, Rosa (Louise Dresser), in a fancy hotel in Monte Carlo -- where Rosa reveals herself as a down-on-her-luck baroness in disguise. Posing as the daughter of the baroness, Toni pursues romance, with unexpected consequences. (Romantic comedy) - 1928

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Zazie Dans le Métro
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An 11-year-old girl causes chaos on the streets of Paris after she runs away from her transvestite uncle. (Comedy) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Murmur of the Heart
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This loosely plotted coming-of-age tale follows the life of 15-year-old Laurent Chevalier (Benoît Ferreux) as he stumbles his way over the burgeoning swell of adolescence in the 1950s France. After having his first sexual experience with a prostitute and dodging the lips of a priest (Michel Lonsdale), Chevalier contracts a case of scarlet fever. When the fever leaves him with a heart murmur, Chevalier is placed in a sanatorium, along with his over-attentive and adulterous mother (Léa Massari). (Comedy drama) - 1971

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: You're Only Young Once
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Judge James Hardy (Lewis Stone), wife Emily, daughter Marian (Cecilia Parker), and son Andy (Mickey Rooney) prepare for their annual vacation. The judge chooses Santa Catalina Island for the good fishing, and everyone settles into their idea of fun. Marian flirts with a wealthy lifeguard who claims to be separated from his wife, and Andy is drawn to an equally wealthy fast girl. But the Hardys' relaxation comes to a halt when the judge learns he has been swindled back home. (Comedy drama) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Andy Hardy's Double Life
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: College-bound Andy Hardy (Mickey Rooney) sells a friend his old jalopy in order to afford to ship his new car to school. After mailing a check away, Andy discovers his friend can't cover the payment and turns to his sister, Marian (Cecilia Parker), and his father, Judge James Hardy (Lewis Stone), for help. Meanwhile, exasperated by Andy's constant flirtations, his girlfriend, Polly (Ann Rutherford), plots to teach Andy a lesson in romance with her sophisticated friend, Sheila (Esther Williams). (Comedy) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Four Girls in White
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Norma (Florence Rice), Mary (Mary Howard), Pat (Ann Rutherford) and Gertie (Una Merkel) are four nursing students hoping that their long education and investment will lead to a well-paying, stable job. When Bob Maitland (Kent Taylor), the son of their hospital's founder, is checked in, Norma falls for his good looks and his fabulous wealth. When she neglects her other patients to dote on Bob, however, her position in the hospital is put in jeopardy. (Drama) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pride and Prejudice
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the early 19th century in the English village of Meryton, the arrival of wealthy bachelors, most notably Mr. Darcy (Laurence Olivier), stirs up the families with single daughters. Among those is the Bennet family, with five eligible daughters, including the spirited Elizabeth (Greer Garson) and her pretty older sister, Jane (Maureen O'Sullivan). As Mrs. Bennet (Mary Boland) aggressively tries to pair off her girls, Elizabeth crosses swords with the imperious Darcy. (Romantic comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Whistling in the Dark
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wally Benton (Red Skelton) isn't a detective, but he plays one on the radio. The confusion between Benton and his crime-solving persona results in a rather perilous situation when cult leader Joseph Jones (Conrad Veidt), greedy for the inheritance of one of his flock, blackmails Benton to craft the perfect murder. Under the watchful eye of Jones' burly thug, Sylvester (Rags Ragland), the actor has to hatch a flawless plot -- or improvise his way out of his predicament. He has until 11 o'clock. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Whistling in Brooklyn
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A murderer, dubbed the Constant Reader for sending notes to the police with exact locations and descriptions of victims, eludes Inspector Holcomb (Henry O'Neill). On a radio program called The Fox, hosted by Wally Benton (Red Skelton), Holcomb hears Wally describe a letter that sounds similar to those from the Constant Reader. Wally, who is about to marry co-star Carol Lambert (Ann Rutherford), is then pursued by the police and determined cub reporter Jean Pringle (Jean Rogers). (Comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Ghost Comes Home
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A missing man (Frank Morgan) returns and learns his wife (Billie Burke) collected on his life insurance. (Comedy) - 1940

ksby.us.title: Weather Gone Viral
ksby.us.description: While dangerous, extreme weather makes for some riveting video and lends itself to being easily shared online and going viral. Such videos of destructive weather are featured on this series, which showcases the weather footage in addition to featuring first-hand accounts of survivors who lived through the treacherous conditions. On-air meteorologists also share their tales of being on the front lines and experiencing the fury that Mother Nature sends their way, sometimes even becoming the story themselves. Tsunamis, lightning storms and tornados are among the weather phenomena that take center stage on "Weather Gone Viral." (Weather, Documentary) - 2015-08-06

ksby.us.title: Storm of Suspicion
ksby.us.description: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series. (Crime, Reality, Weather) - 2018-10-07

moremax.us.description: A social misfit (Sissy Spacek) with psychic powers wreaks havoc at her prom to get even with pranksters. - 1976

moremax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
moremax.us.description: An ancient Celtic ritual drives Dr. Loomis' (Donald Pleasence) patient to sacrifice an entire family in Haddonfield, Ill. - 1995

moremax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
moremax.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

moremax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
moremax.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2002

moremax.us.title: Red Riding Hood
moremax.us.description: Young Valerie (Amanda Seyfried) feels torn between two men. She loves Peter, but her parents intend that she marry wealthy Henry. Valerie and Peter are going to run away together, but her sister is killed by a werewolf before they can put their plan into action. The villagers call on the help of Father Solomon (Gary Oldman), a famous monster hunter who warns that the beast takes human form by day. Then Valerie suspects that the werewolf is someone she loves. (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Romance) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Wolfman
moremax.us.description: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy. (Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The East
moremax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Head Office
moremax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

moremax.us.title: Beirut
moremax.us.description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Dilemma
moremax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Friendship
moremax.us.description: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor. (Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
moremax.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Perfect Match
moremax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Lady Bird
moremax.us.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. (Comedy drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Atomic Blonde
moremax.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, Thriller, LGBTQ) - 2017

moremax.us.title: The Meg
moremax.us.description: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Bring Her Back

moremax.us.title: Gimme Shelter
moremax.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (Documentary) - 1970

moremax.us.title: Hoot
moremax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

moremax.us.title: Leave No Trace
moremax.us.description: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Ore., rarely making contact with the world. But when a small mistake tips them off to authorities, they are sent on an increasingly erratic journey in search of a place to call their own. (Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Hitchcock
moremax.us.description: Following his great success with "North by Northwest," director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel "Psycho." When the studio refuses to back the picture, Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. His wife, Alma Reville, has serious reservations about the film but supports him nonetheless. Still, the production strains the couple's marriage. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2012

moremax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
moremax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Predator

The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. moremax.us.title: The Transporter Refueled

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Please Eat Slowly Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Dumplings Victor shares his tips for making restaurant-quality dumplings at home, from working the meat to create a springy texture, to cooking them just right.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Lunar New Year The new Sydney Fish Market faces its first Lunar New Year. Rare lamington sea urchins hit the market floor and a young fishmonger gambles on unfamiliar tropical rock lobsters.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Vietnam And Thailand Rick Stein's culinary journey continues as he travels down the Mekong River to Vietnam where the food is light and fresh, and prepared using lots of herbs.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E4 Big Island Ono Gordon dives, hunts, forages and forges on Hawai'i's Big Island.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Valetta Ainsley starts his Maltese adventure in Valetta. He joins historian Liam for a tour of the harbour, where he learns why Malta is such a melting pot of cultures and the impact this has on the cuisine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Lemon Chilli Chicken With Turmeric Rice Learn to cook a signature dish at Island Dreams Cafe and an all-round family favourite. Alimah Bilda shares a version with a punchier, thicker sauce that coats the chicken and rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Marlborough We travel to Marlborough. Susan Macdonald and her husband are passionate about Middlehurst station and their sheep. Also, meet Sebastian and Daniela who run La Ruca Food Truck.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Rotorua Sachie meets Ngahi Bidois at a boat ramp on the shores of Lake Tarawera, and they go out on his boat. They tell stories of the region and its connection with the land, water, and the kai.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marcus In The Med: Mallorca
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Med Light Bites Marcus is in search of the ultimate light bites and heads to Port de Soller on Mallorca's west coast, to try their famous Soller prawns.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A New Zealand Food Story
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E7 Episode 7 Ben experiences the Ruapehu's region emerging food story and rich history of market gardening.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of The Tropics
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Taste Of The Tropics: Share Plates Yidinji comedian and actress Steph Tisdell returns to the Far North to explore belonging through food, sharing plates with Indonesian, Kuku Yalanji-Maltese and Sicilian families flavours.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Hoisin Sloppy Janes On Bao Buns Chef Deborah VanTrece kicks off this incredible meal with crispy purple yam Jojos, inspired by the Pacific Northwest.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Ainsley's Festive Flavours 1 Join Chef Ainsley Harriott in a series filled with flavour packed dishes sure to liven up every meal! Explore how spices can work wonders in our food with the perfect brunch, Ras El Hanout Shakshuka.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Black Sesame Tangyuan All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Precious Flavours
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Hop Shoots Hop shoots, also known as Truffles of the North, are harvested only for a few days in February and March. They are the world's most expensive vegetable, sometimes fetching up to $1500 per kilo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Christmas At The Castle
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Puddings On Fire Ho Ho Ho! Get ready for some festive fun with Mark Gregory and Annabelle White in A Magical Christmas Downunder!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Norway Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 One of Norway's most beautiful cities and the perfect place to start. Justine heads straight to the famous fish market, tracking down the ingredients for a classic Norwegian fish soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Episode 4 Paula cooks up a healthy version of a sausage roll with carrot ketchup on the side. She meets a Highland dance teacher and her father then shows them how to make the perfect barbecue lamb kebabs.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Frugal Foodie
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Slow Cooker Cooking Let the slow cooker do the work with Steph's Pulled Chicken Tortillas, Slow cooked BBQ Beef and her scrumptious Lemon Self Saucing Pudding.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Island Bites With Hebridean Baker
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 The Faroes Coinneach explores the islands' tradition of fermentation and learns how to bake Faroese bread.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Sicily This week Jamie heads to the island of Sicily in search of sensational homecooked recipes that set apart from the food of the mainland.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Please Eat Slowly Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Mango Pancakes Learn how to create sumptuous mango pancakes. Victor's French training comes in handy as he shares some simple steps to ensure your crepes come out round and flat every time.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E10 Fearne Cotton Prue is joined in her Cotswold Kitchen by Fearne Cotton.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 South Ainsley explores South Malta, starting in the picturesque fishing harbour of Marsaxlokk where, with a local fisherman Joe, he ventures around the weekly fish market to check out the catch of the day.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Ainsley's Festive Flavours 1 Join Chef Ainsley Harriott in a series filled with flavour packed dishes sure to liven up every meal! Explore how spices can work wonders in our food with the perfect brunch, Ras El Hanout Shakshuka.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Black Sesame Tangyuan All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Precious Flavours
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Hop Shoots Hop shoots, also known as Truffles of the North, are harvested only for a few days in February and March. They are the world's most expensive vegetable, sometimes fetching up to $1500 per kilo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Island Bites With Hebridean Baker
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 The Faroes Coinneach explores the islands' tradition of fermentation and learns how to bake Faroese bread.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Sicily This week Jamie heads to the island of Sicily in search of sensational homecooked recipes that set apart from the food of the mainland.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Please Eat Slowly Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Mango Pancakes Learn how to create sumptuous mango pancakes. Victor's French training comes in handy as he shares some simple steps to ensure your crepes come out round and flat every time.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E10 Fearne Cotton Prue is joined in her Cotswold Kitchen by Fearne Cotton.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Christmas At The Castle
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Puddings On Fire Ho Ho Ho! Get ready for some festive fun with Mark Gregory and Annabelle White in A Magical Christmas Downunder!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Episode 4 Paula cooks up a healthy version of a sausage roll with carrot ketchup on the side. She meets a Highland dance teacher and her father then shows them how to make the perfect barbecue lamb kebabs.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 South Ainsley explores South Malta, starting in the picturesque fishing harbour of Marsaxlokk where, with a local fisherman Joe, he ventures around the weekly fish market to check out the catch of the day.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Black Sesame Tangyuan All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Ainsley's Festive Flavours 1 Join Chef Ainsley Harriott in a series filled with flavour packed dishes sure to liven up every meal! Explore how spices can work wonders in our food with the perfect brunch, Ras El Hanout Shakshuka.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Please Eat Slowly Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Mango Pancakes Learn how to create sumptuous mango pancakes. Victor's French training comes in handy as he shares some simple steps to ensure your crepes come out round and flat every time.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Precious Flavours
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Hop Shoots Hop shoots, also known as Truffles of the North, are harvested only for a few days in February and March. They are the world's most expensive vegetable, sometimes fetching up to $1500 per kilo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Island Bites With Hebridean Baker
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 The Faroes Coinneach explores the islands' tradition of fermentation and learns how to bake Faroese bread.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Sicily This week Jamie heads to the island of Sicily in search of sensational homecooked recipes that set apart from the food of the mainland.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Down Under Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Australia and New Zealand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E10 Fearne Cotton Prue is joined in her Cotswold Kitchen by Fearne Cotton.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Tastes Of Tuscany Mary commemorates her recent travels by creating tasty dishes inspired by Italy, like apple raspberry crostata and mushroom crespelle.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E21 My Goats & Ricotta Lidia grew up around goats, and their delicious milk which were used to make ricotta. She makes spinach ricotta dumplings, an open cookie cannoli, and then ricotta meatloaf with tomato sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Australia Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Kruger Safari Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Nice Our journey heads to Nice the vibrant capital of the French Riviera. For this special day, Luana has designed an itinerary full of surprises, where tradition meets creativity.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Lund, Sweden In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year-old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E3 Denise Andrews Macale: Bush Turkey Stew & Chilli Fresh Water Mussels In White Wine Denise Andrews Macale, with the help of Mitch and Ali, turns the humble bush turkey into a delicious stew using basic vegetables and Asian sauces to complement the gamey taste of this native bird.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Cooking With Grapes Raise a toast to the glorious grape as Simon and Maggie celebrate with the fruit of the vine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E26 Episode 26 Laura makes her delicious Spinach and Feta Rolls in the heart of the Prahran Market. In the Yarra Valley, Charlie Carrington cooks Chicken Enchiladas.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E26 Pesto 2.0 Rachael is known for her delicious and flavourful pesto sauces of all varieties. She prepares a Pesto alla Trapanese, a Sicilian dish made with almonds and tomatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Clontarf Clontarf Reserve is the perfect spot for a BBQ, and Hayden turns things up a notch with recipes featuring beef steaks, lamb cutlets and a pork loin rack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E4 Wendell Pierce Award-winning actor and producer Wendell Pierce is joining Ina for cooking and conversation at the barn.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E21 Episode 21 Laura starts the show in the historic Prahran Market making a simple and heart-warming Potato and Leek Soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Featuring Matt Keenan, Gary brings together fresh, lively flavours in a menu of poke bowl with salmon, cucumber salad, and a Greek style fetta and greens pie served with Yemeni sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E50 Episode 50 Spicy Prawn Tacos and a way to tame those spices with a special visit from Thomas Schnetzler from Lindt who makes a decadent Chocolate Truffle Cake.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E83 Bang For Your Buck Prepare to taste the savings as Adam, musician Sarah McLeod and chef Grant King give you bang for your buck!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Norway Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Justine has big plans for a mountaintop picnic-but the Norwegian weather has other ideas. She takes shelter in a mountain hut instead, where she puts together a beautiful spread of open sandwiches.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Fire & Fat Jess travels to Burnt Bean Co, where the pork chop gets the full BBQ treatment. She then returns home to demonstrate her own version, revealing how to keep the meat juicy, build flavour, and nail the perfect finish on a cut anyone can find.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Spain
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Rice And Peaches Chef Tom Kerridge's journey takes him to Catalonia in his bespoke vintage food truck as he heads to the Ebro Delta, where rice fields cover the landscape.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Poh Cooks Malaysia
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 After 13 years away, Poh returns to Kuala Lumpur to rediscover the flavours that shaped her. From the historic streets of Kampung Baru to a traditional family home and a buzzing wet market.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E11 Foods That Makes You Manly After taking a cyclo-ride through Ho Chi Minh City and trying various foods from roadside vendors and markets, Tony tests his might with a few shots of snake wine and a live cobra heart.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Eating On The Edge Of Nowhere Taking his obsession with the film Apocalypse Now a little too seriously, Tony sets out for Pailin, reputed to be one of the most dangerous towns on Earth.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

ABCMESydney.au.title: Badjelly
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Once Upon A Time Tim and Rose enter the Dark Forest in search of their missing cow, Lucy - setting them on a path towards the horridible witch Badjelly.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E13 Migration As the son of a celebrity, Luka piques special interest in Bob Roth, who would do anything to make money! But Luka himself would do anything to defend his values.and his friends.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Next Step: Cheer ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Flyers As Kenzie changes up the routine, Layla tries to prove she belongs on-mat as a flyer. A new stunt makes Olive nervous. Ruby struggles to reign in her crush on Heath.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Lego Ninjago: Day Of The Departed ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: While Cole battles for his freedom, the Ninja must return their ghostly foes to the Departed Realm before they gain the power to remain in Ninjago forever!

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E5 North Yorkshire George meets couple Paul and Rachel, who want to transform an old goods wagon into a summerhouse and gin bar, and Will meets Sam who's taken on the conversion of a decrepit old narrowboat in a bid to live mortgage-free.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E5 Pants on Fire Lee and Lucy are invited to dinner by Anna and Toby, but Lee is desperate to watch a Norwegian crime series on TV and opens up a can of worms when he gets Lucy to lie that their daughter Molly is ill and they can't make it.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E6 Harvest Of Souls The daredevil riders of the Wall of Death roll into town for Whitcombe Mallet's annual harvest fair, and DCI Barnaby & DS Nelson must unravel a complex feud when the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his own horse.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E4 Last Call A night of partying ends in disaster for Dr. Ross and his date. Benton struggles to show compassion towards a patient with Crohn's disease. Hathaway considers enrolling in medical school, and Carter botches Benton's lecture.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Ben And Holly's Little Kingdom Holly joins Ben and his family on an Elf trip to the seaside, and Mr Elf tells her that no magic is to be used. But when they realise that no one has remembered to pack lunch they ask Holly to use her magic to make some.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 1, 2, 3, Home Flower, Flour, and the neighbourhood kids take over the plaza in a chaotic game of 1, 2, 3 Home. With Rudy's antics, a grumpy cockatoo and some sneaky disguises, who will make it back to home base first?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E36 Dance Mama Dance Flower and Penny practice a new dance in the Dumpling House storeroom, but when the door gets stuck, it's up to Deputy Detective Flour to get them out.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E94 Charity Shop The parents are having a clear-out. The good thing is anything they don't want, can go to the charity shop to help others. With their collection of things in a box, they set off to town and visit the Charity Shop.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E41 Families Peppa and her friends are at playgroup. Today Madame Gazelle and all the children will be drawing pictures of their families.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Bike At the park, Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends' determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 The Doctor Honey is stuck waiting for Dr Bingo as the other, more exciting injuries get seen before her. Receptionist Bluey tells her to be patient, some of these cases are a real pickle!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 Roar Off Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes inadvertently start a massive roar off with all the other Vegesaurs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E1 Minty in the Sky Minty gets a birds-eye view of the Valley after being flung onto the back of a Baby BokChoydactyl.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 The Great Gnome Games After 799 years of winning the Great Gnome Games, Great Gnanna is worried she can't defend her title. To help, the doctors remind her she is just as fearsome as ever.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E29 The We Love Animals Badge Duggee is stroking Enid the cat. The squirrels want to find animals they can stroke as well. Roly wants to stroke a bird but they keep flying off. Betty finds a turtle, but he feels a bit too hard!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Potato Time Today at Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E24 Native Garden School With some help from students, Clarence and Savannah revive a playground garden bed with local native plants.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E12 Big And Small: Garden Luke and Leah are painting flowers and learning about all things big and small in the garden! They cook carrot muffins for a garden picnic. In the big Play School pop-up book, we see a garden with lots of small critters.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piggy Builders ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Model Forest Wilf is convinced there is a treasure beneath Fiona's yurt! He'll do whatever he can to get it, so the Piggies have to try and stop him before things get out of hand.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 The Magic Spyglass / The Stone of Life Santi and crew are after the legendary Magic Spyglass! / Santi and crew follow a map to a special treasure, but Bonnie and Sir Butterscotch are hot on their trail.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Return to Planet Gloop Part I PJ Masks Power Heroes Defeated time and time again, Gloop the Third accepts help from an unlikely ally - Romeo!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 The Way the Windmill Blows/An Muileann Gaoithe The Mechas have their hands full when a windmill won't turn, Sunny Field Farm has no power, and Zee can't launch his rocket.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Nikhil and Jay and the Monster Camp When Jay discovers Nikhil had camped in the wild, he wants to have a monster camping adventure in their garden. Will they meet any monsters? And will Jay be as brave as Nikhil?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Millie Magnificent
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 The Most Magnificent Flight When Ben is disappointed about missing out on a plane trip, Millie and Maya set out give him the most magnificent flight in the backyard.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Stan & Gran
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Get a Wriggle On Sand! Sea! Worms! Stan and Gran have to quickly discover where all these worms came from or Ellie's new clothes drying service will be ruined!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 The Secret Chick On a visit to the farm, Miffy discovers a cute chick she'd love to keep as a pet. So when the chick sneaks into her bag, she decides to keep it a secret.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Cat-Mitten Mittens plays games one way and Pants another. They struggle to find a game they can both play in the same way, but puppies and kittens seem to be really different!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Socks for Kittens Mittens is confused by Pants' gift. Socks? For a kitten? She tries to wear them to his house to say thanks, but kittens don't really wear socks.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E12 Wabash Cannonball Join Simon and Wags the Dog in the Wiggly Kitchen as they come across a red helmet, who could it belong to? It's then time to join The Wiggles, jump on board and sing along to the 'Wabash Cannonball'.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E12 The toddlers are visited by kittens. Fantus helps a little magpie find its parent.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E24 Fractions are a Piece of Cake One has been invited to the Fraction Friends party and first meets One Whole. How will the friends share the party food? Luckily they have a song that helps them work it all out!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Science Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Paddle Boats Can a boat still move without a motor or sail? Luke is putting it to the test in the Science Time Lab, making a paddle boat with household items to propel through the water!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E23 Nursery Rhymes Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their best nursery rhymes with each other.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E21 Digger World Mummy and Daddy Pig, Peppa and George have a wonderful day with Mr Potato at Digger World!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E21 Nonsense Day Kiri and Lou gather Yum Yum Baronies on Nonsense Day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Roller Coaster Brocs The baby Pea-Rexes love to slide down the necks of giant Broccolisaurus, except for Split who is terrified and has to learn to overcome his fears.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E30 The Ant Hill Things are going missing all over the Little Kingdom - Holly has lost her wand and Ben has lost his horn! Soon they realise that ants are stealing their things, and try to persuade the Queen Ant to give them back.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E21 Musical Cuzzy Using a forgotten CD player, Flower and Flour start a game of musical statues, but soon discover Unicorn Cuzzy isn't very good at standing still. Instead, she finds her place in the game in her own unique way.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E3 Dancing Piggy The SuperKitties must rescue Wiggles, their new dancing robo-piggy, from Zsa-Zsa before the Kittydale Dance Party.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E48 The Curse of the Pirate Baby Bonnie Bones transforms into a baby and it's up to the good pirates to change her back.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 The Super Gloopster Gloop III and Owlette get locked into a battle of flying machine : Owlglider vs Gloopster. But Gloop hires alien mechanics Carly and Cartoka to give his ship some extra boost.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E21 The Octonauts and the Sea Skaters When Kwazii gets lost at sea aboard the tiny octo-ski, he meets a flotilla of sea skaters.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 The Paper Boat Badge When Duggee's newspaper gets blown away, the squirrels race to rescue it - and help some stranded ants along the way.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E3 Robo Dotty Neville convinces the lifeguards to purchase a new Robo-Dummy 3000, which they lovingly name 'Robo-Dotty'. But when 'Robo-Dotty' goes rogue, enforcing extreme rules, it's up to the cadets to get things back under control.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S14 E10 Swift Drift When Norman and new boy Peter get lost at sea, Krystyna must pilot the new rescue plane and save them before their ship sinks!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Nikhil and Jay and the Amma's Day Nikhil and Jay have a surprise poem for Mothers' Day but Amma doesn't seem to like it. They need to find something that Amma would really like!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E73 Flights of Fancy Rocket Ten and friends blast off into space for a rhyming adventure to visit planets 11 to 20.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Makery
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Practical Joker The Makery is playing practical jokes on Nim today! It also helps her make a volcano, cook up a fake breakfast, and creates a beam-me-up hat.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Butterflies Fizzy and Suds are thrilled by the colours and shapes of all kinds of butterflies. They even learn about the lifecycle of butterflies with the help of some fairy bread!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School: Magnificent Monsters and More!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S379 E2 Fantastical Fairyland Justine and Alex are in the garden decorating their Cubby Cave! They use umbrellas to create garden monsters and make fairies for the fairy garden. The toys play hide and seek and meet a new friend, Louis the Lizard!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Peppa Pig: Caravan Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure but they don't know where to go!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Peppa Pig: Wedding Party! Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow surprise everyone with their wedding announcement and everyone rallies around to make it memorable!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E5 Tour de Mossy Bottom The Farmer is out of shape so Bitzer encourages him to get fit using an improvised exercise bike from the scrap heap. The bike breaks free from its fixings and is soon travelling cross country along with its oblivious rider.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E45 Ginger Finds Out While the team battles Gor-don, Ginger discovers the Heroes' secret and makes a homemade super-suit to join the fight.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little J And Big Cuz
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E10 Puppy Big Cuz tries to convince Nanna she's ready for a puppy with the help of \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Football Fantastics ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Bear Rescue Taran pretends his favourite teddy doesn't belong to him, but when it goes missing he gets upset. The Fantastics go on a bear hunt and Taran realises he's not too old for teddies.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Spring Clean During a public holiday, Flower and Flour help Penny and Dirk, give the restaurant a spring clean. But the cleanup quickly turns into an epic game of castles, knights, and dragons.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E24 Native Garden School With some help from students, Clarence and Savannah revive a playground garden bed with local native plants.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E37 Roller Disco Madame Gazelle has organised a Roller Disco for the children.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E38 Guinea Pigs Madame Gazelle has brought her pet Guinea Pigs in to show the children. Madame Gazelle is going on holiday and needs someone one to look after them. Who will be the lucky child that gets picked to look after the Guinea Pigs?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: It's Andrew!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 Big BIG Magic Day All the littlecorns are practicing hard for kindy school's Magic Day presentation, but since Andrew doesn't have the Hornsby Downs kind of magic, he has to bring his own kind - and it's rhin-awesome!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Super Monsters: Dia de los Monsters The Super Monsters celebrate Dia de los Muertos with Vida, learning the magic of tradition, friendship, and honoring loved ones in a vibrant parade.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Redwing's First Flight/Absorbing Man Gets Shiny Cap and Iron Man struggle to work as a team when Ultron hits the mall. Absorbing Man steals a gem that deflects the Iron Friends' beams, forcing them to find a new way to stop him.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E13 Little Sheep Of Horrors Intrigued by a horror film on TV, Timmy wanders into the farmhouse late one night. Shaun's rescue mission convinces the Farmer that the place is haunted.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E45 TV Shop At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 The Fun Doctor When Mara calls Pearl sensible, she wants to prove how fun she is. With her eye off the ball, Pearl starts to make medical mistakes. Can she be a fun doctor?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E22 The Election Badge When Eugene unexpectedly drops out of running the Summer Fair, Duggee and the Squirrels hold an Election to decide who's the best candidate for the job.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superbuns
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 Making the Save Buns gets picked last for a pick-up soccer game because her superhero duties cause her to lose focus. She's going to prove herself in goal and never be picked last again.until she notices a little cricket in harm's way!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 Great Yarn Caper The SuperKitties must figure out why someone is stealing all the yarn in Kittydale.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Fart Wizz has a very embarrassing problem. He needs to fart and does NOT want you to watch. So, he tries to make the episode extremely boring.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E46 Chickenrat It's bedtime and Bingo can't remember where she left her beloved Floppy! Retracing their steps, Bingo and Bluey lead Mum through their bizzare day in the hope of tracking her down.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 The Monkey Bars Tamara is very good on the monkey bars since she uses them every day, but Melanie not so good as Tamara never lets her on them. When Melanie demands a proper turn, Tamara is outraged and so a battle of wills begins.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Crookhaven ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 The Crooked Network The school goes into lockdown when the Nameless attack. Gabriel and the gang are on a mission to discover the family secrets that Crookhaven is keeping hidden.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark? ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E1 The Tale of the Haunted Wood Five kids investigate the disappearance of their friend, the leader of the Midnight Society whose fate may be tied to a mysterious curse that haunts their seaside town.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ice Age: A Frozen World
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Battle Of The Humans With both species competing for survival, it's David vs Goliath in the battle of the early humans as Neanderthals fight Homo Sapiens for supremacy. In the Ice Age, a natural disaster will leave only one species standing.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mythbusters: There's Your Problem!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 May The Force Be With You The MythBusters test myths related to the laws of motion, finding out if a Newton's Cradle can be supersized with wrecking balls; comparing a two-car head-on crash versus a single car crashing into a wall, and more.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Space Rockets This time The Slow Mo Guys get ready to launch and look at the amazing world of Space Rockets. How fast can they get a space rocket to travel?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Robot Wars
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E3 Episode 3 This show features an eclectic collection of home-made robots including Glitterbomb, designed by nine-year-old April. In a Robot Wars first, a team of students from Scotland bring a robot made of wood with a petrol engine.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E1 Four Hundred Cartons of Undeclared Cigarettes and a Niblingo George Sr. bails Meemaw and Georgie out of jail. Also, Sheldon and Missy meet Mandy, and Mary feels unwelcome at church.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BTN High ᴺᵉʷ

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E5 The Invisible Enemy: Part 1 An alien virus infects the human crew of a refuelling station on Titan, one of the moons of Saturn. The Doctor is also infected and becomes possessed by the will of the Nucleus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E6 The Invisible Enemy: Part 2 As the Doctor's condition worsens, he instructs Leela to pilot the TARDIS to the Bi-Al Foundation. The only chance of curing the Doctor is to literally get inside his head.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E7 The Invisible Enemy: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela have been cloned and miniaturised and injected into the Doctor's body. There they must fight the virus on a microscopic level before time runs out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E8 The Invisible Enemy: Part 4 The Nucleus has escaped the Doctor's body and grown to human size. Its plans to spawn and infect the whole galaxy are nearing fruition. And it looks like K-9 has a new master….

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E9 Image of the Fendahl: Part 1 The Doctor and Leela arrive in present day England at Fetch Priory where a mysterious skull that is older than mankind is exerting a deadly influence on those around it.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E10 Image of the Fendahl: Part 2 As Thea succumbs to the power of the skull, the Doctor realises that an ancient horror from the mythology of his own people is manifesting at Fetch Priory.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E11 Image of the Fendahl: Part 3 Stahl intends to control the power of the Fendahl for himself. The Doctor and Leela take a trip in the TARDIS to discover the truth about the ancient evil from the dawn of time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E12 Image of the Fendahl: Part 4 Thea has become the Fendahl Core and Stahl realises that he is out of his depth as his followers transform into the hideous, snake-like Fendahleen.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E13 The Sun Makers: Part 1 The TARDIS arrives on Pluto which has been made habitable and turned into a giant factory where the ruthless Company exploits its under-paid workers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S14 E19 The Robots of Death: Part 3 Taren Capel is using the robots to carry out the murders.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S14 E20 The Robots of Death: Part 4 As the robots close in, the Doctor and Leela join forces with the crew to fight back.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E1 Horror of Fang Rock: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on Fang Rock island at the start of the 20th century. There the Doctor and Leela discover a lighthouse keeper has been killed and a creature is at large.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E2 Horror of Fang Rock: Part 2 A thick fog surrounds Fang Rock and a ship is wrecked. The survivors take shelter in the lighthouse but all are in deadly peril from the alien menace that stalks the island.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E3 Horror of Fang Rock: Part 3 The Doctor seals the survivors inside the lighthouse but discovers that he may unwittingly have trapped the creature inside with them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E4 Horror of Fang Rock: Part 4 As the alien Rutan picks off the remaining humans one by one, the Doctor devises a desperate plan to defeat the alien and repel the approaching Rutan mothership.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E15 The Sun Makers: Part 3 The Doctor is free but Leela has been captured by the Gatherer and is sentenced to a grisly death by public steaming.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E16 The Sun Makers: Part 4 The Others launch a full-scale uprising against the Gatherer and his Inner Retinue while the Doctor confronts the real head of the Company.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E17 Underworld: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on a spaceship which is crewed by the survivors of the planet Minyos who are on a quest to find the lost ship, the P7E. Their journey has taken them 100,000 years.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E18 Underworld: Part 2 When their ship crashes beneath the surface of a newly formed planet, the Minyan survivors discover what they have been searching for. But their arrival is not welcomed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E19 Underworld: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela attempt to penetrate the Citadel of the Seers to rescue Idas’s father who has been sentenced to death.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E20 Underworld: Part 4 The Minyans are eager to recover the race banks that they have waited so long to find, but the Doctor becomes suspicious when the Oracle simply allows Jackson to take them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E21 The Invasion of Time: Part 1 Leela is concerned by the Doctor’s strange behaviour when, after a secret meeting with aliens, he returns to Gallifrey and abruptly stakes his claim on the Time Lord presidency.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E22 The Invasion of Time: Part 2 The Doctor is made president of the Time Lords and immediately orders K9 to lower the planet’s defences and has Leela banished to the wilderness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E23 The Invasion of Time: Part 3 The Doctor has betrayed his own people and enabled a Vardan invasion of Gallifrey. Leela joins forces with the Outsiders and prepares to strike back against the aliens.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E24 The Invasion of Time: Part 4 As the Vardans finally fully materialise on Gallifrey, the Doctor prepares to spring his trap. But does a more deadly alien force lie behind the Vardans?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E25 The Invasion of Time: Part 5 The Sontarans have taken control of the Capital on Gallifrey and intend to use the power of the Time Lords to rampage through all of time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E26 The Invasion of Time: Part 6 Stor, the Sontaran leader, finally gains access to the TARDIS in search of the Great Key of Rassilon and a dangerous game of hide and seek begins inside the Doctor’s ship.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E26 The Invasion of Time: Part 6 Stor, the Sontaran leader, finally gains access to the TARDIS in search of the Great Key of Rassilon and a dangerous game of hide and seek begins inside the Doctor’s ship.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E1 The Ribos Operation: Part 1 On a mission to collect the six segments of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Ribos where the first segment is protected by the monstrous Shrivenzale.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E2 The Ribos Operation: Part 2 Garron is attempting to trick the Graff Vynda-K into buying the planet Ribos, but the jethrik that is vital to his plan is really the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E3 The Ribos Operation: Part 3 The Doctor and Romana's search for the first segment of the Key to Time is hampered when the Graff Vynda-K takes them prisoner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E4 The Ribos Operation: Part 4 Pursued into the catacombs by the Graff and attacked by the ferocious Shrivenzale, the Doctor and Romana struggle to stay alive and find the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E5 The Pirate Planet: Part 1 In search of the second segment of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Calufrax. But they find that a completely different planet has taken its place.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E6 The Pirate Planet: Part 2 Still in search of the missing planet, Calufrax, the Doctor and Romana encounter the telepathic Mentiads and Zanak’s ruler, the half man, half robot Captain.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E7 The Pirate Planet: Part 3 The Doctor has discovered the sinister truth about Zanak and solved the mystery of the missing planet. On the Bridge, the Doctor meets the real ruler of Zanak.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E8 The Pirate Planet: Part 4 The Doctor and Romana join forces with the Mentiads to prevent the Captain and Xanxia from using Zanak to consume the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E9 The Stones of Blood: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana track the third segment of the Key to Time to the vicinity of an ancient stone circle on Earth. But sinister forces are at work and the stones hide a secret.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E10 The Stones of Blood: Part 2 The leaders of a druidic cult have been killed and it seems that the stones from the stone circle are alive and have a taste for human blood.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E11 The Stones of Blood: Part 3 As the blood hungry Ogri close in, the Doctor launches a desperate attempt to rescue Romana from hyperspace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E12 The Stones of Blood: Part 4 The Doctor releases two alien justice machines from imprisonment who sentenc him to death. Meanwhile Romana urgently searches for clues that will reveal Vivien Fay’s true identity.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E15 The Androids of Tara: Part 3 While Romana makes her escape from the castle, the Doctor is lured to a meeting with an android duplicate of her that is programmed to kill him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

wrsp.us.title: Storm of Suspicion
wrsp.us.description: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series. (Crime, Reality, Weather) - 2018-10-07

bravowest.us.description: Defying the very notion of good taste, Scary Movie out-parodies the pop culture parodies with a no-holds barred assault on the most popular images and talked-about moments from recent films, television and commercials. The film boldly fires barbs at the classic scenes from Scream, The Sixth Sense, The Matrix, I Know What You Did Last Summer and The Blair Witch Project, then goes on to mock a whole myriad of teen movie clichés, no matter the genre. (Comedy, Horror) - 2000

bravowest.us.title: Scary Movie 2
bravowest.us.description: All the scary movie characters are back in a laugh packed sequel that scares up even more irreverent fun than the original. Starring Regina Hall, Christopher Kennedy Masterson, Tori Spelling and Tim Curry, Chris Elliott and James Woods, nothing's sacred and anything goes in this outlandish must-see comedy hit. (Comedy, Horror) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza
filmriseaction.us.description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI. (Crime drama) - 1993

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003
